verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager can be driven programmatically only through its extensively documented, scriptable CLI. That CLI covers install, add, remove, update, audit, pm subcommands, publish, outdated, why and info, and offers non-interactive flags like --frozen-lockfile and --filter. Machine-readable docs are available via llms.txt and docs.md. No programmatic or HTTP API surface is evidenced, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented programmatic (library/JS or HTTP) API for package-management operations, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of driving it as an API rather than a CLI.
